description: Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica Punta Cacique is a secluded luxury resort overlooking Playa Penca on Guanacaste's Pacific coast. Its short airport transfer, oceanfront setting, spa and refined resort experience make it especially appealing to couples, families and travelers seeking privacy with convenient access to nearby beach towns and private excursions.
hero_description: A secluded oceanfront escape at Punta Cacique with refined design and a short transfer from Guanacaste Airport.
local_insight: Waldorf Astoria Punta Cacique is especially appealing for travelers who value privacy, ocean views and a convenient arrival day. Its position near Playa Hermosa and Playas del Coco also creates useful options for private transfers and day tours.

faq.q: How far is Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica from Guanacaste Airport?
faq.a: The resort is approximately 17 miles from Guanacaste Airport (LIR). Driving time is commonly around 25 to 35 minutes, depending on traffic.

faq.q: Where is Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica located?
faq.a: The resort is located at Punta Cacique on Playa Penca, along Guanacaste's Northern Pacific coast.

faq.q: Can tours pick up at Waldorf Astoria Punta Cacique?
faq.a: Private excursions and transfers can be planned from the resort, with pickup details confirmed according to the selected experience and travel date.

source_notes: Hilton's official location page places the resort on Playa Penca at Punta Cacique, 17 miles from Daniel Oduber Quirós International Airport.
Hilton has described the resort as approximately 25 minutes from the airport; transfer time remains traffic-dependent.
